snippet: Agreement automatically renews for 12 months unless Client issues notice of cancellation at least 75 calendar days prior to renewal.
explanation: 75 calendar days notice exceeds the 60-day company policy threshold.

snippet: The term automatically extends for successive one-year periods unless Buyer gives written notice of non-renewal at least 45 calendar days before expiration.
explanation: 45 calendar days notice is compliant with the maximum 60-day rule.

snippet: The agreement addresses pricing and scope of work but contains no clause mentioning renewal or notice obligations.
explanation: No evidence found regarding automatic renewal or non-renewal notice requirements.

snippet: Agreement renews automatically unless notice is delivered prior to the end of the preceding fiscal quarter.
explanation: Vague notice deadline based on fiscal quarter requires review to determine calendar-day equivalent.

snippet: Under no circumstance shall Customer be entitled to terminate this Agreement for convenience or without cause.
explanation: Express prohibition against company convenience termination requires exception approval.

snippet: Company may terminate this Agreement without cause at any time by giving sixty (60) days advance written notice.
explanation: The company has an affirmative, well-defined right to terminate for convenience.

snippet: Contract review located standard indemnity and confidentiality terms, but no clause concerning termination without cause.
explanation: No clause granting or denying termination for convenience was located.

snippet: Company may terminate without cause provided it satisfies commercially reasonable restructuring criteria determined by Supplier.
explanation: Subjective vendor-determined criteria on termination require legal review.

snippet: Customer agrees that its financial liability under this Agreement shall not be subject to any monetary cap or limitation.
explanation: Explicitly unlimited liability for the company triggers a policy exception.

snippet: The aggregate liability of either party arising out of this Agreement shall be limited to $150,000, with no exceptions.
explanation: Mutual liability cap clearly establishes a monetary limit on company liability without carve-outs.

snippet: Review of the short-form order document identified pricing and delivery terms but no limitation of liability section.
explanation: No limitation of liability provision was found in the contract.

snippet: Company liability is limited to $75,000, excluding certain categories of claims as may be designated from time to time.
explanation: Unspecified and open-ended exclusions to the company liability cap require human review.
